Only SEQ ID NO: 22 is the isolated antibody domain (IH4vs2). Additionally, 'cdr_modified' is flagged as the text states the mutations in IH4vs2 are for 'efficient secretion', which typically involves framework residues rather than Complementarity Determining Regions (CDRs), and no explicit mention of CDR modification is found.
